_source: NIST Computational Chemistry Comparison and Benchmark Database (CCCBDB), experimental vibrational fundamentals. Entered by hand from the standard literature values for these five molecules rather than scraped -- CCCBDB is form-driven and has no bulk API. Every value here is a textbook fundamental for a small, unambiguous molecule, chosen so a reader can check them without a database.
_units: cm-1, experimental FUNDAMENTALS (anharmonic). Computed values are HARMONIC, which is why they run systematically high and why a scaling factor is fitted rather than assumed.

_excluded.acetone: Run and parsed, but NOT scored. 24 modes, many of them mixed methyl rocks and deformations whose experimental assignment is not one-to-one with a sorted frequency list -- matching them by index would manufacture pairs rather than measure them. Its C=O stretch is checked separately as a single named band.
_excluded.benzene: Same reason, 30 modes with several degenerate pairs.
